name: What is the difference between a custom pool design and choosing a pre-designed pool shape?
description: Custom pool design is bespoke to your property and preferences, while pre-designed pools use standard templates with less flexibility.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom pool design and choosing a pre-designed pool shape?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom pool design is a bespoke creation, meticulously shaped to fit your specific property, lifestyle, and aesthetic preferences, often incorporating unique features and seamlessly integrating with your home. Pre-designed pool shapes are standard templates that offer less flexibility in size, features, and integration. While pre-designed options can be quicker and sometimes less expensive, they may not optimize your space or reflect your unique vision as precisely as a custom design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom pool design is bespoke to your property and preferences, while pre-designed pools use standard templates with less flexibility.
